notes: Medicine, porcelain and equipment rolls are independent; a victory can award up to three items, one per group.
Every granted item is quantity one, bound. No cash substitution or template quality randomness.
Equipment candidate IDs/levels/base details are client_verified, assignment/rates/binding are designed; historical PC guide supports equipment drops up to level 80 only.
Porcelain +/-5 eligibility is client_verified description; 20% group chance and 60/30/10 group weights are designed. Historical 10-49 range is not imposed on this client.
Role XP and bound silver retain the v1 designed formula for now; this revision adds content/atomic pet rewards, not a claim of final balancing.
Cash adds a designed scene_level*2 per victory to fund restored cash-only NPC expenses; bound silver remains a separate scene_level*2 credit, no implicit conversion.
Ordinary unmodified single-role single-enemy battles only. Multiple-time buffs, teams, events, rare materials and death penalties require separate policies.
Already persisted v1 admissions retain v1 plans; a v2 retry must not silently rewrite them.
